title: fragaria vesca subsp. californica
intro: Fragaria vesca subsp. californica, commonly known as the California wood sorrel or California wild strawberry, is a subspecies of the wood sorrel plant native to the western coast of North America. It is prized for its edible leaves and fruits, which have been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to their numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria vesca subsp. californica include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
